g.text: Pi-rendered recovery card and manual NFC read-back
submit: JSON job + codes-only UTF-8 file
Encode QR, render fonts and separate side rasters
The CLI has no PDF, QR, image or font renderer.
Keep login passwords separate from recovery codes.
Start with fictional data; neither QR nor NFC is encryption.
Inspect exact front and back previews
Plan and run front (explicit operator action)
Confirm rest, inspect front, record verdict
Flip and seat card in the same guide
Plan and run back (separate operator action)
Confirm rest, inspect back, record verdict
Scan finished QR; compare source payload
Prepare and secure an independent paper backup
Manual NFC Tools workflow, not a CLI or Pi NFC adapter.
Check tag compatibility and full NDEF storage first.
Optional tag read protection cannot protect the QR.
Do not expose an antenna or chip to the laser.
Explicitly choose one English NDEF Text record
If the card is unavailable, use the separate paper backup.
After loss or suspected copying, replace the code set
and every backup. A spare copy does not revoke a lost one.
Follow instructions; use one unused code
Mark code spent with marker; clear temporary copies; store card
